title: Infos pratiques 2026 — HOKA UTMB Mont-Blanc (Internet Archive snapshot)
claims: Bibs can be collected at the start village of the runner's own race or in Chamonix; the reservation window runs from 1 July to 10 August inclusive.

Shuttle buses to the start are included in the bib for UTMB, CCC, OCC, TDS, MCC, ETC and YCC, but a reservation is mandatory; pre-shuttles run from Cluses, Sallanches, Le Fayet, Servoz and the Chamonix valley.
The Prevention and Health Pathway (PPS) is mandatory for adults, costs €5 and replaces the medical certificate; it must be completed before bib collection.
Bib transfer, deferral to another year and category change are not allowed.
Cancellation insurance can refund 100% of the registration fee in case of injury before the event and 50% for other covered reasons; it must be taken out at registration.
Rescue insurance covering search and evacuation in France, Italy and Switzerland is mandatory for every runner.
